name: American Silver Eagle
title: American Silver Eagle melt value today
about: The US Mint's silver bullion coin and the most traded one in the country. Each holds one troy ounce of .999 silver, with the weight and purity backed by the US government. The design changed partway through 2021 from the heraldic eagle to an eagle landing, so you'll find both versions dated that year.
description: How much silver is in an American Silver Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Canadian Silver Maple Leaf
title: Canadian Silver Maple Leaf melt value today
about: Canada's silver bullion coin, struck by the Royal Canadian Mint in .9999 silver, a step purer than most. Coins since 2014 carry radial lines and a tiny engraved maple leaf as security features, which makes fakes harder to pass.
description: How much silver is in a Canadian Silver Maple Leaf, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: British Silver Britannia
title: British Silver Britannia melt value today
about: The Royal Mint's silver bullion coin. It's been .999 fine since 2013. Britannias from 1997 to 2012 were struck in .958 Britannia silver on a slightly heavier blank, so they still hold an ounce.
description: How much silver is in a British Silver Britannia, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Austrian Silver Philharmonic
title: Austrian Silver Philharmonic melt value today
about: Struck by the Austrian Mint in Vienna, with the Vienna Philharmonic's instruments on one side and the great organ of the Golden Hall on the other. It's one of the most traded silver coins in Europe.
description: How much silver is in an Austrian Silver Philharmonic, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Mexican Silver Libertad
title: Mexican Silver Libertad melt value today
about: Mexico's silver bullion coin, with the Winged Victory statue from Mexico City's Independence Monument on it. Far fewer are made each year than Eagles or Maples, and they usually cost more over spot.
description: How much silver is in a Mexican Silver Libertad, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Australian Silver Kangaroo
title: Australian Silver Kangaroo melt value today
about: The Perth Mint's silver bullion coin, struck in .9999 silver with a leaping kangaroo on the reverse. Unlike Perth's Kookaburra and Koala, the design doesn't change each year, which keeps it a plain bullion coin.
description: How much silver is in an Australian Silver Kangaroo, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight and purity.

name: South African Silver Krugerrand
title: South African Silver Krugerrand melt value today
about: The silver version of South Africa's famous gold coin, first struck in 2017 for the Krugerrand's 50th anniversary. It holds one ounce of .999 silver and carries a face value of one rand.
description: How much silver is in a South African Silver Krugerrand, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Chinese Silver Panda
title: Chinese Silver Panda melt value today
about: China's silver bullion coin, with a new panda design every year, so it draws collectors as well as stackers. Since 2016 it's been struck in 30 grams of silver rather than a full troy ounce, which is about 0.96 oz.
description: How much silver is in a Chinese Silver Panda, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: America the Beautiful 5 oz silver coin
title: America the Beautiful 5 oz silver coin value today
about: Five ounces of .999 silver, struck by the US Mint from 2010 to 2021 with one design for each national park or site in the quarter series. They're three inches across, and a few designs had small mintages that collectors now look for.
description: How much silver is in an America the Beautiful 5 oz silver coin, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Morgan silver dollar
title: Morgan silver dollar melt value today
about: Struck from 1878 to 1904 and again in 1921, the Morgan dollar is 90% silver. Even worn, common Morgans usually sell above melt, and key dates, Carson City coins and high grades bring far more. The Mint's new Morgans from 2021 on are .999 silver and hold a little more.
description: How much silver is in a Morgan silver dollar, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Peace silver dollar
title: Peace silver dollar melt value today
about: The Peace dollar followed the Morgan in 1921 and was struck until 1935, with the same silver in each coin. Like Morgans, they usually sell above melt even when worn, and a few dates are scarce.
description: How much silver is in a Peace silver dollar, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Walking Liberty half dollar
title: Walking Liberty half dollar melt value today
about: Adolph Weinman's Walking Liberty half was struck from 1916 to 1947. Many collectors call it the most beautiful US coin, but worn common dates trade as junk silver, close to melt.
description: How much silver is in a Walking Liberty half dollar, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Franklin half dollar
title: Franklin half dollar melt value today
about: Struck from 1948 to 1963 with Benjamin Franklin on the front and the Liberty Bell on the back. Circulated Franklins usually trade with other junk silver, near melt.
description: How much silver is in a Franklin half dollar, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: 1964 Kennedy half dollar
title: 1964 Kennedy half dollar melt value today
about: 1964 was the only year the Kennedy half was struck in 90% silver for circulation. Halves from 1965 to 1970 dropped to 40% silver, and the ones made for spending after that have none.
description: How much silver is in a 1964 Kennedy half dollar, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: 40% Kennedy half dollar
title: 40% Kennedy half dollar silver value today
about: From 1965 to 1970 the Kennedy half was struck in 40% silver. They look a lot like later halves that have no silver at all, so check the date.
description: How much silver is in a 40% Kennedy half dollar, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Silver Washington quarter
title: Silver quarter value today, 1964 and earlier
about: Washington quarters dated 1964 and earlier are 90% silver. From 1965 on they're copper and nickel, which shows as a copper stripe on the edge, so a plain silver edge is the quick tell.
description: How much silver is in a silver Washington quarter, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Standing Liberty quarter
title: Standing Liberty quarter melt value today
about: Struck from 1916 to 1930 and 90% silver. The date wore off many of them in circulation, and those trade as junk silver.
description: How much silver is in a Standing Liberty quarter, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Mercury dime
title: Mercury dime melt value today
about: The Winged Liberty Head dime, struck from 1916 to 1945 and better known as the Mercury dime. Worn common dates trade as junk silver, while a few dates like 1916-D are worth far more.
description: How much silver is in a Mercury dime, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Silver Roosevelt dime
title: Silver dime value today, 1964 and earlier
about: Roosevelt dimes dated 1964 and earlier are 90% silver. From 1965 on they're copper and nickel, so the date tells you which you have.
description: How much silver is in a silver Roosevelt dime, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: War nickel
title: War nickel silver value today
about: From late 1942 through 1945 the Jefferson nickel was made with 35% silver to save nickel for the war. Look for a large mint mark above Monticello on the back.
description: How much silver is in a war nickel, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: 40% Eisenhower dollar
title: 40% Eisenhower dollar silver value today
about: Most Eisenhower dollars have no silver. The exceptions are the 40% silver coins San Francisco made for collectors from 1971 to 1976. They have an S mint mark, but so do some Ikes with no silver, so check which set yours came from.
description: How much silver is in a 40% Eisenhower dollar, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: 1 oz silver round
title: 1 oz silver round value today
about: A round is a coin-shaped piece of silver made by a private mint. It isn't legal tender and has no face value, so it usually costs less over spot than a government coin with the same silver.
description: What a 1 oz silver round is worth at live silver spot, with its weight and purity and what to know before you buy or sell one.

name: 10 oz silver bar
title: 10 oz silver bar value today
about: Ten ounces of .999 silver in one bar. Bars cost less over spot per ounce than coins, and ten ounces is the size a lot of stackers move to once single coins start to add up.
description: What a 10 oz silver bar is worth at live silver spot, with its weight and purity and what to know before you buy or sell one.

name: 100 oz silver bar
title: 100 oz silver bar value today
about: The biggest bar most people buy, a little under seven pounds of .999 silver. It has the lowest premium per ounce of anything here, but you sell it whole, so some stackers prefer smaller bars they can sell a few at a time.
description: What a 100 oz silver bar is worth at live silver spot, with its weight and purity and what to know before you buy or sell one.

name: 1 kilo silver bar
title: 1 kilo silver bar value today
about: A kilogram of .999 silver, which is 32.15 troy ounces. Kilo bars are the standard size in Europe and Asia and fall between ten ounce and hundred ounce bars on premium.
description: What a 1 kilo silver bar is worth at live silver spot, with its weight and purity and what to know before you buy or sell one.

name: American Gold Eagle (1 oz)
title: American Gold Eagle melt value today
about: The US Mint's gold bullion coin. It's 22 karat gold, alloyed with silver and copper so it wears well, which is why the coin weighs more than an ounce but holds exactly one ounce of gold. It's the gold coin US dealers know best when you sell.
description: How much gold is in a 1 oz American Gold Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: American Gold Eagle (1/2 oz)
title: 1/2 oz American Gold Eagle melt value today
about: The half ounce Gold Eagle, 22 karat like the one ounce coin. Smaller sizes cost more over spot per ounce, but they're easier to sell a little at a time.
description: How much gold is in a 1/2 oz American Gold Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: American Gold Eagle (1/4 oz)
title: 1/4 oz American Gold Eagle melt value today
about: The quarter ounce Gold Eagle. It costs more per ounce than the one ounce coin, and a lot of people buy it as a middle step between a tenth and a full ounce.
description: How much gold is in a 1/4 oz American Gold Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: American Gold Eagle (1/10 oz)
title: 1/10 oz American Gold Eagle melt value today
about: The smallest Gold Eagle and a common first gold coin. The premium per ounce is the highest in the series, so it makes more sense as a start or a gift than as the main way to buy gold.
description: How much gold is in a 1/10 oz American Gold Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: American Gold Buffalo
title: American Gold Buffalo melt value today
about: The US Mint's pure gold coin, with James Earle Fraser's design from the Buffalo nickel. At 24 karat it's softer than a 22 karat Eagle, so it scratches more easily. Handle it by the edges.
description: How much gold is in an American Gold Buffalo, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: South African Krugerrand
title: Krugerrand gold value today
about: The first modern gold bullion coin and still one of the most traded. It's 22 karat, so the coin weighs 33.93 grams to hold one ounce of gold. There's no face value on it.
description: How much gold is in a South African Krugerrand, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Canadian Gold Maple Leaf
title: Canadian Gold Maple Leaf melt value today
about: Canada's gold bullion coin, struck in .9999 gold by the Royal Canadian Mint. Newer coins carry radial lines and a tiny engraved maple leaf to make them harder to fake.
description: How much gold is in a Canadian Gold Maple Leaf, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Austrian Gold Philharmonic
title: Austrian Gold Philharmonic melt value today
about: Austria's gold bullion coin and one of the most traded in Europe, with the same orchestra design as the silver Philharmonic.
description: How much gold is in an Austrian Gold Philharmonic, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: British Gold Britannia
title: British Gold Britannia melt value today
about: The Royal Mint's gold bullion coin, .9999 gold since 2013. Earlier Britannias were 22 karat but still held an ounce of gold. Because it's UK legal tender, it's free of capital gains tax for UK residents.
description: How much gold is in a British Gold Britannia, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Australian Gold Kangaroo
title: Australian Gold Kangaroo melt value today
about: The Perth Mint's gold bullion coin, first issued in 1986 as the Australian Nugget. The kangaroo on the back changes every year.
description: How much gold is in an Australian Gold Kangaroo, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Chinese Gold Panda
title: Chinese Gold Panda melt value today
about: China's gold bullion coin, with a new panda each year. Since 2016 the size that used to be one ounce has been 30 grams of gold, which is about 0.96 oz.
description: How much gold is in a Chinese Gold Panda, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: British Sovereign
title: Gold Sovereign value today
about: Struck since 1817 and still made today. It's easy to sell almost anywhere in the world, and as UK legal tender it's free of capital gains tax for UK residents.
description: How much gold is in a British Sovereign, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Mexican 50 Pesos gold coin
title: Mexican 50 Pesos gold coin value today
about: The Centenario, first struck in 1921 for a hundred years of Mexican independence and one of the heaviest gold coins ever made for circulation. Most you'll find are restrikes dated 1947, which is fine for bullion.
description: How much gold is in a Mexican 50 Pesos gold coin, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: $20 Double Eagle
title: $20 gold Double Eagle value today
about: The $20 gold piece, in the Liberty design from 1850 to 1907 and the Saint-Gaudens design from 1907 to 1933. Common dates usually sell above melt because collectors want them too.
description: How much gold is in a $20 Double Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: $10 Eagle
title: $10 gold Eagle value today
about: The $10 gold piece, in the Liberty design until 1907 and the Indian Head design from 1907 to 1933. Like other gold from before 1933, it usually sells above melt.
description: How much gold is in a $10 Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: $5 Half Eagle
title: $5 gold Half Eagle value today
about: The $5 gold piece, struck in several designs until 1929. Old US gold usually sells above melt, and some dates are worth much more.
description: How much gold is in a $5 Half Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: $2.50 Quarter Eagle
title: $2.50 gold Quarter Eagle value today
about: The $2.50 gold piece, last struck in 1929. Like other old US gold, it usually sells above its melt value.
description: How much gold is in a $2.50 Quarter Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Swiss 20 Francs gold coin
title: Swiss 20 Francs gold coin value today
about: Best known as the Vreneli, struck from 1897 to 1949. It's a common way to buy gold in small pieces in Europe.
description: How much gold is in a Swiss 20 Francs gold coin, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: French 20 Francs gold coin
title: French 20 Francs Rooster gold value today
about: Often called the Rooster after the design struck from 1899 to 1914. It holds the same gold as the Swiss 20 francs, since both followed the same standard.
description: How much gold is in a French 20 Francs gold coin, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight and purity.

name: 1 gram gold bar
title: 1 gram gold bar value today
about: The smallest gold bar most dealers sell, about the size of a fingernail. The premium over spot is high for its size, so it works better as a start or a gift than as an efficient way to buy.
description: What a 1 gram gold bar is worth at live gold spot, with its weight and purity and what to know before you buy or sell one.

name: 10 gram gold bar
title: 10 gram gold bar value today
about: Ten grams of .9999 gold, a little under a third of an ounce. It's a common size in Europe and Asia.
description: What a 10 gram gold bar is worth at live gold spot, with its weight and purity and what to know before you buy or sell one.

name: 1 oz gold bar
title: 1 oz gold bar value today
about: One troy ounce of .9999 gold from a refiner like PAMP, Valcambi or the Perth Mint. Bars usually cost a little less over spot than one ounce coins, and most come sealed with an assay card.
description: What a 1 oz gold bar is worth at live gold spot, with its weight and purity and what to know before you buy or sell one.

name: 1 kilo gold bar
title: 1 kilo gold bar value today
about: A kilogram of gold, which is 32.15 troy ounces. The premium per ounce is low, but it's a lot of money in one piece and you can't sell part of it.
description: What a 1 kilo gold bar is worth at live gold spot, with its weight and purity and what to know before you buy or sell one.

name: American Platinum Eagle
title: American Platinum Eagle melt value today
about: The US Mint's platinum bullion coin and the only US coin made of platinum.
description: How much platinum is in an American Platinum Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Canadian Platinum Maple Leaf
title: Canadian Platinum Maple Leaf melt value today
about: The Royal Canadian Mint's platinum bullion coin, first struck in 1988.
description: How much platinum is in a Canadian Platinum Maple Leaf, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight and purity.

name: 1 oz platinum bar
title: 1 oz platinum bar value today
about: One troy ounce of .9995 platinum. Platinum usually carries a bigger premium than gold because much less of it trades as bullion.
description: What a 1 oz platinum bar is worth at live platinum spot, with its weight and purity and what to know before you buy or sell one.

name: American Palladium Eagle
title: American Palladium Eagle melt value today
about: The US Mint's palladium coin, with Adolph Weinman's Winged Liberty from the Mercury dime on the front.
description: How much palladium is in an American Palladium Eagle, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight, purity and years.

name: Canadian Palladium Maple Leaf
title: Canadian Palladium Maple Leaf melt value today
about: The Royal Canadian Mint's palladium bullion coin, made in much smaller numbers than the gold and silver Maples.
description: How much palladium is in a Canadian Palladium Maple Leaf, what it's worth at live spot, and its weight and purity.

name: 1 oz palladium bar
title: 1 oz palladium bar value today
about: One troy ounce of .9995 palladium. Most palladium goes into catalytic converters, so its price swings harder than gold or silver.
description: What a 1 oz palladium bar is worth at live palladium spot, with its weight and purity and what to know before you buy or sell one.
